title: Platformer
summary: A side-on platformer. Run with the arrow keys, jump with Space. Reach the finish to win.

parts.what: CameraFollow keeps the hero in the middle of the screen as it moves.
parts.try: Change Smoothness: lower numbers make the camera lag behind more.

parts.what: Plain sprites with a BoxCollider2D, so things can stand on them.
parts.try: Select a Platform, press Ctrl+D to copy it, and drag the copy somewhere new.

parts.what: PlatformerController runs with the arrow keys or A/D and jumps with Space. RigidBody2D adds gravity, and Health gives 3 hits before the level restarts.
parts.try: Set Jump Power to 16 for a floaty jump, or Extra Jumps to 1 for a double jump.

parts.what: Collectible adds 1 to game.stars when the hero touches it, then disappears. Bob makes it float up and down.
parts.try: Set Amount to 5 on one of them to make a super star.

parts.what: Hazard takes 1 health from whatever tagged 'player' touches it, and knocks it back.
parts.try: Raise Knockback to 12 for a big bounce.

parts.what: Patrol walks back and forth, and Hazard hurts the hero on contact.
parts.try: Make one faster: set Patrol Speed to 4.

parts.what: Touching it runs scripts/platformer_finish.es: on_trigger checks it's the player, then broadcasts "win".
parts.try: Drag the Finish somewhere harder to reach.

parts.what: ScoreDisplay shows game.stars on screen. Collectibles add to it when you pick them up.
parts.try: Change its Format, for example to "Loot: {}".
